steps.title: Start here
steps.body: Today shows the Daily Mission and your personal picks. Accept one to send it to your phone.

steps.title: Mission cards
steps.body: Each card has a hook, a setup and a win condition. Accept the one you will play.

steps.title: Go live
steps.body: This page issues your stream address and key. The key stays masked until you reveal it.

steps.title: Clips
steps.body: Every Start and Done becomes one Short. Watch the render stage here.

steps.title: Results
steps.body: Enter views and retention, then read which mission types are working.

steps.title: Replay this tour
steps.body: Open Help any time to replay the tour or read the guide.

steps.title: Admin overview
steps.body: System health, recent jobs and AI usage in one place.

steps.title: Games
steps.body: Add a game, then run daily research to turn it into sourced ideas.

steps.title: Pool
steps.body: Approve the ideas you want and assign one to a creator.

steps.title: Studio
steps.body: Import a recording, find the moments and generate a captioned Short.

steps.title: Calendar
steps.body: Schedule the approved Shorts and keep the cadence.

steps.title: Long-form
steps.body: Assemble a session's Shorts into one video.

steps.title: Models
steps.body: Pull, unload and free the local models, and watch live memory.

steps.title: Setup status
steps.body: The same checks as make doctor: database, storage, AI key and voice model.
